The solar radiation Titan gets should have converted all of its simple hydrocarbons into more complex organic compounds by now, so the fact that methane & company are being detected means there's some unknown process releasing more. That's the point of interest.

What types of theories could be supported by the lack of presence of complex organic compounds? What does methane, ethane, etc being present in place of the organic compounds indicate, exactly, beyond there being a supposed agitation that indicates an increase of the substances?

Could be an unknown chemical reaction taking place on the surface or underground, could be geological activity like cryovolcanism bringing it up from underground reservoirs. The possibility people are REALLY hoping for is life, but there obviously aren't any forests or large animals running around, so I don't think anything short of landing a robot on Titan's surface to inspect some pond "water" under a microscope would be able to confirm that.
